description: Pedestrian Counting System (counts per hour) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. This dataset contains hourly pedestrian counts since 2009 from pedestrian sensor devices located across the city. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are foot-traffic, pedestrian, safemobility, sensors, traffic-flow. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
